summary.text: Cynthia Laskevich, also known as Cindy, is the Republican candidate for the Vermont House of Representatives in the Rutland-6 District in the November 3, 2026 general election; she advanced from the Republican primary on August 11, 2026. She is a marketing consultant.

paragraphs.text: Cynthia Laskevich was born in Melrose, Massachusetts, and her career experience includes working as a marketing consultant.
According to Ballotpedia, she has been affiliated with Moms for Liberty, Parents Defending Education and Rutland County Republicans.
